cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says learner records are linked to the national ID or another government system.
cells.note: Since 2024 the ministry, through the DGECS, has enrolled pupils of public and private schools on one platform, each with a matricule number and their marks, extended to most classes in 2025-26 (GIN-002). Nothing links the records to the national ID, so not 5.
